name: domino-quadruped-studio
description: Offline simulation, telemetry, calibration, diagnostics and firmware workspace for Domino.
author: Domino Quadruped Project

scripts.desktop:package: npm run build && npm run desktop:prepare && electron-builder --dir --x64
scripts.desktop:make: npm run build && npm run desktop:prepare && electron-builder --win nsis zip --x64
scripts.desktop:publish: npm run build && npm run desktop:prepare && electron-builder --win nsis zip --x64 --publish always
scripts.test: node --test app-state.test.mjs ardupilot-companion-adapter.test.mjs boxer-hid.test.mjs cad-endpoint.test.mjs chart-axis.test.mjs companion-service.test.mjs control-state.test.mjs desktop/paths.test.mjs desktop/project-files.test.mjs firmware-service.test.mjs gait-lab.test.mjs gamepad-profile.test.mjs heartbeat-state.test.mjs linkage.test.mjs live-battery-state.test.mjs live-calibration-state.test.mjs live-companion-adapter.test.mjs live-companion-core.test.mjs live-connection-state.test.mjs live-controller-state.test.mjs live-diagnostics-state.test.mjs live-float-state.test.mjs live-gait-state.test.mjs live-manual-control-state.test.mjs live-navigation-protocol.test.mjs live-navigation-state.test.mjs live-preview-grounding.test.mjs live-safety-state.test.mjs live-sensor-state.test.mjs live-session-state.test.mjs live-telemetry-state.test.mjs live-view-state.test.mjs physics.test.mjs presentation-preferences.test.mjs project-bundle.test.mjs server.test.mjs
